svg.text: R11 162 kΩ + RV5 50 kΩ trim (1 V/oct)
U2 = TL072: pin 8 to +15 V, pin 4 to −15 V, 100 nF to ground at each.
U1: 100 nF from pin 16 and from pin 8 to ground, right at the adapter.
Unmarked values from SSI2144 datasheet Rev 3.0, Figures 1 and 3.
